headline: Turkey Secures $1.9 Billion in Wind and Solar Power Tenders
summary: Turkey secured $1.9 billion in expected investments through its latest wind and solar power tenders covering 18 sites, according to the energy minister.
why: Large-scale renewable energy tenders drive capital expenditure in the clean energy sector and impact utility infrastructure providers.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: New project allocations expand utility-scale solar and wind infrastructure development.
